newsletter.subject: Library reopens Saturday
newsletter.text:
The Brookhollow Public Library reopens this Saturday after an 18-month, $3.4 million renovation that added a children's wing and a recording studio.
Doors open at 10 a.m. Parking on Elm Street is free all weekend.
